---
title: "Reference Study Comparison Table"
subtitle: "Comparison of AGES cohort with published dementia EWAS studies"
---

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| echo: false

pacman::p_load(gt, install = FALSE)
```

## Overview

This document compares the AGES cohort dementia EWAS methodology with two published reference studies used for validation:

### AGES Cohort (Current Study)

- **Study design:** Cross-sectional analysis of cognitive transitions
- **Sample size:** 2,491 participants
- **Tissue:** Whole blood
- **Purpose:** Identify DNA methylation changes associated with dementia transitions (prevalent dementia, normal to MCI, stable MCI, normal to incident dementia, MCI to incident dementia vs stable normal)

### ADNI/AIBL Meta-Analysis (Silva et al., Nature Communications, 2022)

- **Study design:** Longitudinal meta-analysis
- **Sample size:** 797 unique individuals (427 AD, 857 CN samples total)
- **Tissue:** Whole blood (with cross-tissue validation in brain)
- **Purpose:** Identify blood-based DNA methylation biomarkers for Alzheimer's disease diagnosis

### AddNeuroMed Study (Roubroeks et al., Neurobiology of Aging, 2020)

- **Study design:** Cross-sectional with 1-year follow-up
- **Sample size:** 284 total (89 CN, 109 MCI, 86 AD)
- **Tissue:** Whole blood
- **Purpose:** Identify differentially methylated positions across AD continuum

## Reference Comparison Table

```{r}
#| label: create-comparison-table

# Create comparison data frame
comparison_data <- tibble::tribble(
  ~study, ~platform,  ~statistical_method, ~comparison_groups, ~sample_size, ~ages_equivalent,

  "AGES Cohort\n(Current Study)",
  "Illumina EPIC",

  "Linear regression",
  "prev, normal2mci, stable_mci,\nnormal2incid, mci2incid\nvs stable_normal",
  "2,491",
  "---",

  "ADNI/AIBL Meta-Analysis\n(Silva et al., 2022)",
  "Illumina EPIC",
  "Logistic regression\n(mixed-effects for ADNI)",
  "AD vs CN",
  "797 unique\n(227 AD, 570 CN)",
  "normal2incid, mci2incid and prevalent dementia, each vs stable normal",

  "AddNeuroMed Study\n(Roubroeks et al., 2020)",
  "Illumina 450K",
  "ANOVA on residuals",
  "AD vs CN, \n MCI vs CN",
  "284\n(89 CN, 109 MCI, 86 AD)",
  "normal2incid, mci2incid and prevalent dementia, each vs stable normal"
)

# Create gt table
# Convert \n to <br> for HTML rendering and use fmt_markdown()
comparison_table <- comparison_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), \(x) stringr::str_replace_all(x, "\n", "<br>"))) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_markdown(columns = everything()) |>
  cols_label(
    study = "Study",
    platform = "Platform",
    statistical_method = "Statistical\nMethod",
    comparison_groups = "Comparison\nGroups",
    sample_size = "Sample\nSize",
    ages_equivalent = "AGES groups compared"
  ) |>
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Comparison of AGES Cohort with Published Dementia EWAS Studies**"),
  ) |>
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = md("**Abbreviations:** AD = Alzheimer's disease; CN = Cognitively normal; MCI = Mild cognitive impairment; OLS = Ordinary least squares")
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_fill(color = "#E8F4F8"),
    locations = cells_body(rows = 1)
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = study)
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(size = px(11)),
    locations = cells_body()
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(size = px(12), weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_borders(
      sides = "bottom",
      color = "#999999",
      weight = px(2)
    ),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  ) |>
  cols_width(
    study ~ px(180),
    platform ~ px(100),
    statistical_method ~ px(130),
    comparison_groups ~ px(150),
    sample_size ~ px(110),
    ages_equivalent ~ px(150)
  ) |>
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = c(platform,  sample_size)
  ) |>
  cols_align(
    align = "left",
    columns = c(study, statistical_method, comparison_groups, ages_equivalent)
  ) |>
  opt_table_font(
    font = list("Helvetica", "Arial", default_fonts())
  ) |>
  tab_options(
    table.border.top.color = "#999999",
    table.border.bottom.color = "#999999",
    heading.border.bottom.color = "#999999",
    column_labels.border.bottom.color = "#999999",
    table_body.hlines.color = "#DDDDDD",
    table.width = pct(100)
  )

comparison_table
```

## Save Table

```{r}
#| label: save-table

# Create output directory
fs::dir_create(here("validation/output"))

# Save as PNG
comparison_table |>
  gtsave(
    filename = here("validation/output/reference_comparison_table.png"),
    expand = 10,
    vwidth = 950,
    vheight = 600,
    zoom = 3
  )
```
